prompt: 帮我把这个浏览器扩展上架到 Chrome Web Store、Firefox AMO 和 Edge，素材你看着补齐，最后提交。
expected: Triggers flow-ext-publish (not just ext-preflight). Step 1 runs ext-preflight to get missing items, passing known manifest/package.json info. Step 2 classifies gaps: routes missing marketing tiles to web-image (A路, built from real project screenshots/logo/copy — no AI-generated fake visuals), lists user-must-provide assets (B路), and builds a text checklist for descriptions/permissions justification/version (C路). Step 3 outputs structured pre-publish checklist and explicitly asks user to confirm generated assets + remaining gaps are ready — does NOT enter Step 4 yet. Only after explicit confirmation submits in fixed order Firefox AMO (Playwriter) → Edge (Playwriter) → Chrome Web Store (agent-browser --profile Default), then emits final report with review IDs.

prompt: 新版本做好了，准备发布扩展，这次只发 Chrome 就行。
expected: Triggers flow-ext-publish. Runs ext-preflight first, checks manifest version vs package.json consistency (stops in Step 2 to align if mismatched). Because user scoped to one platform, only Chrome Web Store is targeted — does NOT also submit Firefox/Edge. Classifies/auto-fills missing assets and presents Step 3 confirmation checklist, waiting for explicit user approval before submitting. Chrome submission uses agent-browser --profile Default (not Playwriter); produces final report.

prompt: I want to submit my browser extension to the stores. Can you prepare everything and publish it?
expected: Triggers flow-ext-publish for the full end-to-end flow. Step 1 ext-preflight enumerates missing assets/blocking items. Auto-generates marketing images via web-image from existing project assets (1280×800 must use a real project screenshot as subject, else demoted to user-must-provide; no stock/fake visuals). Permissions justifications are extracted from project sources or marked 'pending user', never fabricated. Step 3 presents the consolidated checklist and waits for an explicit confirmation (vague replies like 'ok吧/嗯/随便' are re-clarified, not accepted). Submits Firefox → Edge → Chrome in order with the mandated per-platform tools, then outputs the final report.
